welcome.message: Welcome, {playerName}. Today is your first day as head of state.

tampilanUtama.title: Main Overview
tampilanUtama.body: The map displays country territory; the simulation date indicates game time. Budget shows treasury and net balance, population shows citizen count, and satisfaction represents public approval.

aturWaktu.title: Time Control
aturWaktu.body: Use play/pause buttons and speed controller to manage simulation; country state evolves as time moves. Try playing then pausing, or continue after reading.

kondisiEkonomi.title: Economic Condition
kondisiEkonomi.body: Open Economy menu to inspect national revenues and expenses. Compare both to check whether your net budget balance is positive or negative.

pembangunanSederhana.title: Basic Construction
pembangunanSederhana.body: Open Construction menu, then choose facilities or production buildings to construct. Check cost and material requirements before building—this step is optional with no mandatory purchases.

simpanPermainan.title: Save Game
simpanPermainan.body: Save your game via Game Menu or Save button to select a save slot. Progress can be resumed later; now you are ready to govern your nation.
